This '''Basilisk war droid''' was owned by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Chop'aa Notimo]] during the time of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. During the [[rescue of Garm Bel Iblis]], it was destroyed by [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]].

==History==
At some point before [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Chop'aa Notimo]] came into possession of the droid. During his duel with [[Galen Marek]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], Notimo summoned the droid to assist him against the Sith apprentice and mounted it. Despite its firepower, Starkiller gained the upper hand, crushing the droid using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] before throwing it against a wall. Notimo survived the droid's destruction, but was slain shortly afterward by Marek.
